_meta.note: Engine & genset DC. START SYSTEM IS 12V (eng/gen start batteries, starters, alternators, glow plugs, main switches, battery-parallel relays all 12V). 24V appears only via the engine-room charge feed and shunt context. Voltages are noted in component names. Start batteries (ENG_START_BATT, GEN_START_BATT) are SEPARATE from the 24V SERVICE bank BATT.

Engine main switch feeds ENG-side battery-parallel contactor K01 (sheet 600)
Generator main switch feeds GEN-side battery-parallel contactor K02 (sheet 600)

SAFETY: K01 and K02 are the battery-parallel/emergency-parallel contactors. When energised they bridge the engine and generator 12V start batteries (W610/W640). Closing both parallels the two start banks for emergency cranking. Bridge link inferred from schematic layout; coil-control logic (BATTERY PAR. switch -S4 on engine panel sheet, X4) not fully traced.

Engine start alternator charges engine start battery (sheets 600/630). Routed through charge regulator U01.
Generator start alternator charges generator start battery (sheets 600/630).

SAFETY: charge regulator U01 controls the main alternator field/charge to the 24V SERVICE bank (ALTERNATOR node fed via DCMS_F04 125A). Cross-ref /630 ALT_CONT to K60. Field-control link inferred, not directly traced through to the service bank.
U01 RUN/REG output to alternator control relay K60 (eng-room sheet, ref /630.7F-8E)

Glow plugs (Volvo D2-75 diagram pos 5) fed from engine 12V start system via main switch. Exact feed point not directly readable; on Volvo OEM harness.
Stop solenoid on Volvo OEM harness, 12V engine system. Inferred.
